sources.title: Llama-2 13B-chat Model Overview - emergentmind.com
sources.snippet: Llama-2 13B-chat is a 13 billion-parameter, GPT-style dialogue model that combines autoregressive pretraining with a three-stage safety alignment pipeline. It leverages supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning from human feedback to achieve robust multi-turn dialogue performance.

sources.title: Models | meta-math/MetaMath | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Overview of Available Models MetaMath provides a suite of fine-tuned language models specifically optimized for mathematical reasoning. These models are derived from several base architectures including Llama 2, Mistral, and Llemma, and are available in various parameter sizes.
